newsitem.title: USA: Enron eyes joint venture with ENEL - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Enron eyes joint venture with ENEL - WSJ.

text.p: Enron Corp is expected to announce a joint venture under which it will acquire about $3 billion of the generating assets from Italian utility giant L'Ente Nazionale per L'Energia Elettrica, the Wall Street Journal said.
In Tuesday's electronic edition, the Journal said the joint venture would be created with the idea of eventually marketing power in a deregulated Europe.
Terms of the deal are still to be negotiated. However, a letter of intent is expected to be announced later on Tuesday.
Houston-based Enron is one of the world's largest natural gas and electricity companies.
Enron officials said they anticipated the 50-50 joint venture would include about $2.4 billion in debt financing with an initial $300 million equity investment by Enron being matched by ENEL.
ENEL would contribute 5,000 megawatts of existing generating capacity.
